purpose: Teach: ワークス/昨年度/前記/隻/女史/船長/無職/北東

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 協力会社のワークスとの連携を強化しましょう
lines.en: Let's strengthen our collaboration with our partner companies.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful opening. Measured pace, steady eye contact. Speaking from authority but inviting participation with 'let's.' Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。昨年度の販促データを共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll share last year's promotional data with them.
lines.style: Responsive and efficient. Quick nod in the voice. No hesitation—he knows this is coming. Professional ease, like checking items off a list together.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 前記の通り、新方針で進めましょう
lines.en: As I mentioned, let's move forward with the new policy.
lines.style: Light reinforcement, not repetition. Calm, assured. The tone of someone who's thought this through. Minimal breath before the next point.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。タンカー一隻のリースを確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll confirm the lease details for the tanker.
lines.style: Quick, attentive. Slight emphasis on 'confirm'—he's taking ownership. No drag. Professional precision underneath the courtesy.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の女史的リーダーを招きましょう
lines.en: Let's invite a female industry leader as a speaker.
lines.style: Deliberate and thoughtful. Slight weight on the purpose. Speaking from conviction, not just procedure. Open and inclusive in tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。船長経験者を講師にお招きします
lines.en: Yes. I'll invite someone with captain-level experience to lead the session.
lines.style: Confirming with specificity. He understands the intention and is narrowing the focus. Steady, no flourish. Professional courtesy at the close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 無職期間も評価に含めない平等採用にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make our hiring fair—we won't penalize employment gaps in our evaluation.
lines.style: Firm but not forceful. The words carry policy weight. Steady breath throughout. The tone of someone stating something that should be obvious but needs to be said anyway.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。北東地区の市場調査を進めます
lines.en: Agreed. I'll move forward with the market research in the northeast district.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Crisp, settled. He's been listening and this is his confirmation of the full picture. Warm but professional close.
